description.value: Sweet 7 is a global mango drink and fruit tea chain that started in 2006 and has grown to over 1500 stores worldwide, with its Robson Street location serving Vancouver's busy West End. The brand specialises in fresh-fruit beverages brewed with raw ingredients and no artificial flavourings, drawing on Asian drink-shop tradition while catering to Canadian tastes. Robson Street is a high-traffic pedestrian and cycling corridor, making this a convenient stop for riders exploring the seawall or Stanley Park area.
